design.TT: actual target AGRI, actual-time frozen-R COT
design.FT: SimVP forecast AGRI, actual-time frozen-R COT
design.TF: actual target AGRI, SimVP forecast AGRI -> frozen R COT
design.FF: SimVP forecast AGRI and its frozen-R COT

interpretation: All arms use the same fixed seed42 AC head; TT is oracle same-time reference, FF is a fixed-head operational-input replay but not a trained forecast-GHI head or publication score.
upstream_bank_selection: All 271 sequences come from the prebuilt CPP-supported validation bank; no additional CPP mask filter was applied in the GHI attribution. Results are limited to this bank cohort.
